steps.description: 检查宿主、Termux、命令权限和核心安装状态。SAF 不属于首次安装前置。
准备 Termux bootstrap 和宿主命令通道；已完成时跳过。
仅检查 RUN_COMMAND Android 权限。未授权时显示延迟卡片并暂停；只有用户点击后才可打开权限页。
显示三行 Termux 命令卡片。用户必须在 Termux 执行 mkdir、allow-external-apps 和 termux-reload-settings 后返回。不得使用 SAF 写配置。
等待用户明确在 Termux 中执行完三行配置命令（包括 termux-reload-settings）并返回。打开 Termux 不等于配置已生效。
仅在用户确认执行三行配置命令后运行无副作用探针；exitCode=0 且 stdout 去除首尾空白后等于 wuxianpi-termux-ready 才继续，不投递资源。

arguments.command: set -eu; export PREFIX="${PREFIX:-/data/data/com.termux/files/usr}"; export PATH="$PREFIX/bin:/system/bin:/system/xbin${PATH:+:$PATH}"; command -v tmux >/dev/null 2>&1 || { pkg update -y; DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold install -y tmux; }; tmux new-session -d -s wuxianpi-setup 'exec "$PREFIX/bin/bash" -l' 2>/dev/null || true; tmux has-session -t wuxianpi-setup

steps.description: 第一段基础环境：只按需安装 tmux，使用正确展开的 Termux PATH 创建并验证持久 tmux 会话。

arguments.command: set -eu; export PREFIX="${PREFIX:-/data/data/com.termux/files/usr}"; export PATH="$PREFIX/bin:/system/bin:/system/xbin${PATH:+:$PATH}"; updated=0; update_index() { if [ "$updated" -eq 0 ]; then pkg update -y; updated=1; fi; }; missing=0; for command in jq curl tar gzip zstd find awk flock pgrep sv service-daemon node npm; do command -v "$command" >/dev/null 2>&1 || missing=1; done; ca_status="$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Status}' ca-certificates 2>/dev/null || true)"; if [ "$missing" -ne 0 ] || [ "$ca_status" != 'install ok installed' ]; then update_index; DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold install -y bash jq curl ca-certificates tar gzip zstd coreutils findutils gawk util-linux procps termux-services; fi; node_major="$(node -p 'process.versions.node.split(".")[0]' 2>/dev/null || printf 0)"; case "$node_major" in ''|*[!0-9]*) node_major=0;; esac; if [ "$node_major" -lt 24 ] || ! command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then update_index; if ! DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold install -y nodejs-lts; then DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold install -y nodejs; fi; fi; for command in jq curl tar gzip zstd tmux sv service-daemon node npm find awk flock pgrep; do command -v "$command" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf 'missing Termux command: %s\n' "$command" >&2; exit 1; }; done; node_major="$(node -p 'process.versions.node.split(".")[0]')"; [ "$node_major" -ge 24 ] || { printf 'Node.js >= 24 is required, got %s\n' "$(node -v)" >&2; exit 1; }; mkdir -p "$HOME/workspace" "$HOME/.local/share/openhouseai" "$HOME/.local/share/wuxianpi" "$PREFIX/var/service" "$PREFIX/var/log" "$PREFIX/tmp"

steps.description: 第二段基础环境在 tmux 内完成：只安装精确核心依赖、当前 Runtime 必需的 zstd 和 Node.js >=24，不执行 pkg upgrade，不安装 proot-distro。所有依赖和工作目录验证成功前，禁止获取资源。

arguments.command:
set -u; export PREFIX="${PREFIX:-/data/data/com.termux/files/usr}"; export PATH="$PREFIX/bin:/system/bin:/system/xbin${PATH:+:$PATH}"; market='https://wuxianpirescue.webefficacy.com'; root="$HOME/.local/share/openhouseai/resource-manager"; work="$root/first-install-market"; state="$root/first-install-market.state"; rm -rf "$work"; mkdir -p "$work"; market_install() ( set -eu; curl -q -fsS --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 "$market/api/v2/resource-sets/openhouse-core-stack" -o "$work/catalog.json"; latest="$(jq -r '.latestVersion // empty' "$work/catalog.json")"; [ -n "$latest" ]; jq -e --arg version "$latest" '.versions[] | select(.version == $version)' "$work/catalog.json" >"$work/resource-set.json"; jq -e '.guide.title | strings | length > 0' "$work/resource-set.json" >/dev/null; jq -r '.guide.markdown' "$work/resource-set.json"; sequence="$(jq -r '.sequence' "$work/resource-set.json")"; cache="$root/market-cache/openhouse-core-stack-$sequence"; mkdir -p "$cache" "$work/manager"; id=openhouse-resource-manager; version="$(jq -r --arg id "$id" '.resources[] | select(.id == $id) | .version' "$work/resource-set.json")"; archive="$(jq -r --arg id "$id" '.resources[] | select(.id == $id) | .archive' "$work/resource-set.json")"; size="$(jq -r --arg id "$id" '.resources[] | select(.id == $id) | .size' "$work/resource-set.json")"; digest="$(jq -r --arg id "$id" '.resources[] | select(.id == $id) | .sha256' "$work/resource-set.json")"; [ "$archive" = openhouse-resource-manager.tgz ]; curl -q -fL --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 120 "$market/resources-v2/$id/$version/$archive" -o "$cache/$archive.part"; [ "$(stat -c '%s' "$cache/$archive.part")" = "$size" ]; [ "$(sha256sum "$cache/$archive.part" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$digest" ]; mv -f "$cache/$archive.part" "$cache/$archive"; [ "$(tar -tzf "$cache/$archive" | sed 's#^./##' | sed '/^$/d')" = openhouse-resource-manager ]; tar -xzf "$cache/$archive" -C "$work/manager" --no-same-owner; [ "$(head -n 1 "$work/manager/openhouse-resource-manager")" = '#!/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/bash' ]; install -m 700 "$work/manager/openhouse-resource-manager" "$PREFIX/bin/openhouse-resource-manager"; "$PREFIX/bin/openhouse-resource-manager" market --set "$work/resource-set.json" --market-origin "$market" ); if market_install; then printf 'installed
' >"$state"; printf 'market_content=installed
'; else code=$?; printf 'fallback
' >"$state"; printf 'market_content=fallback market_exit=%s
' "$code"; fi

steps.description: 市场优先路径：读取 promoted 的 openhouse-core-stack 和组合指南，先安装最新版资源管理器，再逐资源下载并安装差异内容。失败时输出 market_content=fallback，由后续 APK 离线步骤接管。
仅当市场内容步骤失败时，开放 APK 的本机 HTTP 总包并返回 Termux 离线导入命令。
仅在市场失败时下载 APK canonical TAR 并安装五个离线核心资源。投递和运行激活仍是独立阶段。

arguments.command: set -eu; export PREFIX="${PREFIX:-/data/data/com.termux/files/usr}"; installed="$HOME/.local/share/openhouseai/resource-manager/installed-set.json"; test -s "$installed"; jq -e '.schema == 4 and .id == "openhouse-core-stack" and (.resources | length) == 15' "$installed" >/dev/null; for file in "$PREFIX/bin/openhouse-resource-manager" "$PREFIX/bin/openhouse-resource-import" "$PREFIX/bin/wuxianpi-setup" "$PREFIX/bin/openhouse-control-plane-start" "$PREFIX/libexec/openhouse/_termux-services-env.sh" "$PREFIX/libexec/openhouse/start-service-manager.sh"; do test -x "$file" || { printf 'missing installed script: %s\n' "$file" >&2; exit 1; }; done; printf 'content=installed source=market resources=15\n'

steps.description: 市场路径只核验已安装集合和关键脚本存在，不执行安装目录逐文件 Hash，也不启动服务。
APK 回退路径等待 delivery=ready 和 content=installed，不等待 Ubuntu，也不要求运行激活。

arguments.command: set -eu; export PREFIX="${PREFIX:-/data/data/com.termux/files/usr}"; mkdir -p "$PREFIX/var/service" "$PREFIX/var/log" "$PREFIX/var/lock"; for file in "$PREFIX/bin/openhouse-control-plane-start" "$PREFIX/libexec/openhouse/start-service-manager.sh" "$PREFIX/libexec/openhouse/_termux-services-env.sh" "$PREFIX/libexec/openhouse/bootstrap/50-install-runtime-components.sh" "$PREFIX/libexec/openhouse/bootstrap/60-start-smallphone.sh"; do test -x "$file" || { printf 'missing activation script: %s\n' "$file" >&2; exit 1; }; test "$(head -n 1 "$file")" = '#!/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/bash' || { printf 'invalid Termux launcher shebang: %s\n' "$file" >&2; exit 1; }; done; "$PREFIX/bin/wuxianpi-setup" activate

steps.description: 独立激活 service-manager 和 WuxianPi；激活前校验 env 脚本、50/60 脚本、固定入口和 Termux 绝对 shebang。必须验证带 Token 的服务列表、带 ai layer 的 registry/apply、registry/sync 和 20765。失败不回滚已安装资源。
要求 activation=ready、canonicalAuthReady、serviceListReady、registryFileReady、registryApiReady 和 wuxianPiHealth 全部为 true。
读取 canonical 端口和 Token，保存到 Android 私有存储，并把连接信息交给当前维修对话。
核心资源和运行激活均通过后，标记当前 APK offer 已完成；Ubuntu 不参与该标记。

arguments.command: set -eu; export PREFIX="${PREFIX:-/data/data/com.termux/files/usr}"; if ! command -v proot-distro >/dev/null 2>&1; then pkg update -y; DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold install -y proot-distro; fi; "$PREFIX/bin/wuxianpi-setup" ubuntu

steps.description: 最后按需安装 proot-distro，再安装 Ubuntu rootfs 和基础包。失败时保留全部核心运行环境，并提供单独重试。
汇总 Ubuntu 后置阶段；Ubuntu 失败不得将已经完成的核心安装改写为失败。
